visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young female with brown hair and a pink t-shirt stands in a brightly lit hallway, smiling and talking directly to the camera. Large red and white text overlays the center of the frame. (2) The scene cuts to a bedroom where a young male in a striped polo shirt is looking at papers. The female approaches him, and they engage in a lively conversation. Yellow question mark graphics appear around his head. (3) The male character looks puzzled while looking directly at the camera. A large 'Q1' and '手扒雞' (Hand-pulled chicken) text appears at the bottom. (4) Transition to the next challenge phase where 'Q2' and a '蹦!' (Boom!) caption appear on screen. The male character reacts with surprise and points towards the camera as light bulb graphics appear above him. (5) Montage of two workers, a man and a woman in black 'Royal-Tex' branded uniforms, installing a screen door in a living room. They use rollers and cutters to fit the black mesh into a white frame. (6) Close-up shots of the new screen door features. A hand is shown touching the mesh. Graphic icons for PM2.5, dust, and insects are shown being blocked. (7) Split-screen comparison shows 'Before' (dirty, grey screen) and 'After' (clear, black screen) across windows and doors. (8) The female creator, the male friend, and the male worker stand together in a room holding a trophy and the new screen frame, clapping and smiling at the camera.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: The video starts in a narrow hallway with white walls. It moves to a cluttered bedroom with a wooden bunk bed and colorful bedding. The promotional segment takes place in a standard living room with a TV, trophies on a cabinet, and windows leading to a balcony.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Fast-paced high-arousal female speech introduces a challenge. Upbeat acoustic pop music plays in the background with a steady 4/4 beat. (2) A sharp 'Ding' SFX marks the start of a game phase. A low-fidelity recording of a nostalgic jingle ('手扒雞') is played, followed by a 'Whoosh' transition. (3) A sudden 'Pop' explosion sound effect triggers a reaction. The male voice exhibits a rising intonation of surprise. (4) A recording of a street vendor's truck ('修理紗窗') is played with distinct room resonance. (5) Transition to a more structured VO narration with professional clarity. Rhythmic clicking and scraping sounds of tools are synchronized with the visual montage of screen installation. (6) High-frequency digital UI 'ping' sounds occur as text features appear. (7) Final segment features a mix of rhythmic clapping, joyful laughter, and a bright musical resolution stinger.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Hook -> Challenge -> Reveal -> Problem Identification -> Solution/Product Introduction -> Result Comparison -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video uses a nostalgic 'sounds of childhood' guessing game to grab attention before pivoting into a promotion for 'Royal-Tex' high-tech dustproof screen doors. It highlights the poor condition of old screens and showcases the professional installation and functional benefits (PM2.5 blocking, waterproof) of the new product.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct product demonstration, visual branding on worker uniforms, dedicated feature list, and before-and-after comparison.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video effectively bridges variety-show entertainment with commercial advertising through a thematic link of household sounds and maintenance.
